name: Neo-Psychedelia
description: A hypnotic modal groove that blooms into a phased instrumental freakout before dissolving into tape-warped decay.

defaults.concept: Neo-psychedelia — warm analog synths and fuzzed guitars drenched in phaser/flanger modulation, thickly layered vocal harmonies soaked in reverb, and a hypnotic, head-nodding groove sitting just behind the beat. Tape-warped textures throughout, building to an extended instrumental freakout mid-song before dissolving into decay.

slots.label: The Phased Wash
slots.purpose: FEEL: Disorienting, submerged. TRICK: Run the entire intro through a slow phaser sweep so nothing sits still in the stereo field before the groove locks in.
slots.groove: Phased, swirling synth pad wash with a lazy filtered drum loop easing in; no strong downbeat yet.

slots.label: The Hypnotic Pocket
slots.purpose: FEEL: Hypnotic, submerged in a warm haze. PRODUCTION NOTE: Bury the vocal slightly under the instrumental bed with heavy plate reverb, so lyrics are felt more than parsed.
slots.groove: Thick, compressed drums sitting just behind the beat; phaser sweeping slowly across the hi-hats.

slots.label: Blooming Wide
slots.purpose: FEEL: Blooming, wider, more saturated. TRICK: Stack the vocal in parallel thirds and fifths and drench it in a longer reverb tail than the verse to open the space up.
slots.groove: Drums open up and saturate harder; layered vocal harmonies stack in wide reverb, groove still sits behind the beat but hits harder.

slots.label: The Freakout
slots.purpose: FEEL: Full freakout — disorienting and euphoric at once. TRICK: Introduce a backwards guitar or vocal swell and a tape-speed wobble across the whole mix bus. This section can be trimmed for a shorter edit without breaking the song's arc.
slots.groove: Backwards swells, tape-warped pitch wobble, and a loose, exploratory fill pattern replace the steady pocket entirely.

slots.label: Tape Dissolve
slots.purpose: FEEL: Dissolving, a comedown. TRICK: Let tape saturation and wow/flutter increase gradually until the mix sounds like it's physically decaying rather than fading via a volume automation.
slots.groove: Everything dissolves into tape hiss and decaying reverb tails; the groove slows and unravels rather than cutting.
